title: Simple Portal
description: A datapack that implements simple portal teleportation.
body:
The datapack implements simple teleportation function of portals in Portal.

Develop in 1.21.11 and do not ensure the compatibility for older versions.

## Features

* Portal Gun
  - use `function portal_gun:give` to give a portal gun.
  - Right click and left click to create portals.
* Portals
  - Entities go through one portal and will appear at another portal with momentum!

## Dependencies

* [Bookshelf View](https://modrinth.com/project/rkt9Av0Z) (Required)
* Bookshelf Hitbox (Required) Bookshelf View already has a built-in version so that you do not need to download it.
* [Player Motion](https://modrinth.com/project/oDhxdGVZ) (Required)
